clips.title: The story
paras: Ahanu's Leather Goods is a bundled consignment of finished leather armor and supplies crafted atop the mesas of Thunder Bluff. Prepared by the leatherworker Ahanu, the parcel is bound for the Crossroads in the Barrens to supply wandering hunters and adventurers.

The supply lines of the Horde depend on practical trade between established strongholds and frontier outposts. In Thunder Bluff, the artisan Ahanu works raw hides into finished apparel and gear, preparing this consignment specifically for trade beyond Mulgore. The bundle is destined for Jahan Hawkwing, a merchant operating in the bustling heart of the Barrens at the Crossroads. Because overland travel across the plains is slow, transporting the bundle introduces messengers to the aerial courier network maintained by the tauren, relying on Tal and Devrak's trained wind riders to ferry goods swiftly across long distances.
